special_rules.name: Allegiance: Space Wolves
special_rules.text:
All units with the Space Wolves Keyword gain the Allegiance: Space Wolves special rule. The Allegiance: Space Wolves special rule consists of the following rules:

- Vlka Fenryka: Space Wolves units gain the following benefits:
    - They gain the Night Vision special rule.
    - They gain the Counter Attack special rule.
- Lessons of Russ: The following restrictions apply to stalwart traditionalist space wolves who heed no master but Leman Russ:
    - Space Wolves units may never voluntarily be placed in Deep Strike or use the Deep Strike special rule. This does not apply to Space Wolves Drop Pod units. Space Wolves units forced into Deep Strike reserves may arrive via Deep Strike.
    - If your opponent is fielding Thousand Sons, you must play 1 additional Battle Round of the game, regardless of the rules in the Battlepack.
    - You may not take Allies from Codex - Imperial Agents.

special_rules.name: Armoury of the 6th Legion
special_rules.text:
Units with Allegiance: Space Wolves have access to additional options presented in this supplement in addition to the Wargear presented in the core Codex - Space Marines.

Wargear

Any Space Wolves Castraferrum Dreadnought unit may exchange one of its Dreadnought Close Combat Weapons and Storm Bolter for a Blizzard Shield for 20pts.

Any Space Wolves unit may take a Wolf Tail Talisman for 1pt per model.

Weapons

Any Space Wolves Castraferrum Dreadnought unit may exchange one of its Dreadnought Close Combat Weapons and Storm Bolter for a Helfrost Cannon for 10pts.

Any Space Wolves model may:

- Exchange their equipped Power Sword for a Frost Sword for 1pts
- Exchange their equipped Power Axe for a Frost Axe for 1pts.
- Exchange their equipped Lightning Claw for a Frost Claw for 1pts per claw.
- Exchange their Dreadnought Close Combat Weapon & Storm Bolter for a Great Frost Axe for 5pts.

special_rules.name: True Grit
special_rules.text: All Boltguns and Storm Bolters a unit with this special rule are equipped with are treated as Pistol 2 type while the equipped unit is within 3" of an enemy unit.

special_rules.name: Curse of the Wulfen
special_rules.text: A unit with this special rule has +1 to its Strength (S) and Attacks (A) characteristics. In addition, it gains the Frenzy special rule.

special_rules.name: Daemon
special_rules.text: A unit with this rule gains the Daemon Keyword. The Daemon unit has a 5+ Invulnerable save and the Fear (1) special rule. Daemon units have +1" to their Movement (M) characteristic. (This is included in unit data sheet)

special_rules.name: Company of Heroes
special_rules.text: During deployment, you may opt to deploy this unit as 1 unit or instead, declare that the unit will disperse. Each model in the unit is treated as its own unit from then on and gains the Character special rule for the rest of the battle. If this unit is deployed as 1 unit, the unit is treated as Infantry type unless the majority of models are equipped with Bike or Thunderwolf options.

special_rules.name: Iron Priest
special_rules.text: A model upgraded to be an Iron Priest gains the Battle Smith (1) special rule. In addition, they exchange their Power Armour, Boltgun, Bolt Pistol and Chainsword for Helfrost Pistol and Tempest Hammer.

special_rules.name: Jarl
special_rules.text: Only 1 Theiygn Battle Leader in your army may be upgraded to be a Jarl. A model with this upgrade gains +1 to their Weapon Skill (WS), Ballistic Skill (BS), Wounds (W), Attacks (A), Initiative (I) and Leadership (LD) characteristics. The model also gains the Battle-Hardened special rule. The model gains a Belt of Russ. They gain the Jarl Keyword.

special_rules.name: Rune Priest
special_rules.text:
A model upgraded to be a Rune Priest gains the Psyker (1) and Adamantium Will special rules. In addition, the model exchanges its Chainsword for a Force Stave.

- The Rune Priest may exchange its Force Stave for one of the following:
    - Runic Sword for 5pts.
    - Runic Axe for 10pts.
- The Rune Priest may take a Psychic Hood for 10pts.

special_rules.name: Wolf Priest
special_rules.text: A model upgraded to be a Wolf Priest gains the Priest (1), Stubborn, Hatred and Zealot special rules. In addition, any attached unit gains the Feel no Pain (6+) special rule.

special_rules.name: Lone Wolf
special_rules.text: A model upgraded to be a Lone Wolf gains the Last Stand, Monster Hunter and Expendable special rules.

special_rules.name: Hero of the Bloodclaws
special_rules.text: This unit may only join Bloodclaws units. This unit may never be your Warlord.

special_rules.name: Wolf Brothers
special_rules.text: The two Wolf Companions that accompany Ragnar Blackmane do not count towards the number of models that may be placed in a Transport and do not prevent him from embarking on a Transport.

special_rules.name: The Last Laugh
special_rules.text: When this unit would be slain and removed from play in the Combat Phase, roll a D6. On a 4+, any units that were engaged in combat with this model or were attached to this unit are also slain and removed from play.

special_rules.name: Transport
special_rules.text: This model can transport 12 Infantry models.

special_rules.name: Champion of Grimnar
special_rules.text: If this unit is your Warlord, they gain the Feel no Pain (5+) and Last Stand special rules.

special_rules.name: Champion of the Deathwolves
special_rules.text: If this unit is your Warlord, it inflicts +D6 Hammer or Wrath Hits at Initiative Step 10 in a turn in which it performed a successful charge. In addition, your Warlord gains the Hit & Run special rule.

special_rules.name: Chosen Student
special_rules.text: During Deployment, select 1 Space Wolves unit in your army with the Character special rule that does not have the Unique Keyword. The selected unit gains +1 to its Weapon Skill (WS), Attacks (A), Initiative (I) and Leadership (LD) characteristics for the rest of the game as Ulriks chosen student.

special_rules.name: Jarl of the Blackmanes
special_rules.text: If this unit is in your Warlord, once per game, you may declare a savage charge. If you do so, all Space Wolves units in your army gain the gain the Furious Charge special rule until the start of your next Movement Phase.

special_rules.name: Jarl of the Champions of Fenris
special_rules.text: If this unit is your Warlord, you may field Theiygn Battle Leaders without taking up a Force Organization Slot.

special_rules.name: Jarl of the Deathwolves
special_rules.text: If this unit is your Warlord, you may field Fenrisian Wolves as Troops choices with the Support Squad special rule.

special_rules.name: Jarl of the Drake Slayers
special_rules.text: If this unit is your Warlord, Theiygn Guard units in your army may be taken as Troops choices but gain the Support Squad special rule and ignore the Limited: 1 Per Detachment special rule.

special_rules.name: Jarl of the Redmaws
special_rules.text: If this unit is in your Warlord, you may field 1 Wulfen unit as a Fast Attack choice. In addition, all Space Wolves units in your army count as scoring 1 additional wound for the purposes of determining who won combat.

special_rules.name: Storm Caller
special_rules.text: If this unit is your Warlord, all attacks in the Shooting Phase against this unit and any attached unit are resolved as Snap Shots.

special_rules.name: Tempest's Wrath
special_rules.text: Each time Njal Stormcaller successfully casts a Psychic Power, all enemy units within 12" take D6 Strength 3 automatic hits with no AP. Wound rolls must be made as normal. Saves may be taken as normal.

special_rules.name: The Last of the Company of Russ
special_rules.text: If this unit is your Warlord, all friendly Space Wolves units that can draw visibility to this unit may re-roll failed Pinning and Panic tests. In addition, this unit counts as a Chapter Banner.

special_rules.name: Saga of Majesty
special_rules.text: A model with this Saga gains +1 to their Leadership (LD) characteristic.

special_rules.name: Saga of the Bear
special_rules.text: A model with this Saga gains +1 to their Toughness (T) characteristic.

special_rules.name: Saga of the Beast Slayer
special_rules.text: A model with this Saga gains the Monster Hunter special rule.

special_rules.name: Saga of the Hunter
special_rules.text: A model with this Saga gains the Infiltrate special rule.

special_rules.name: Saga of the Warrior Born
special_rules.text: A model with this Saga gains +1 to their Weapon Skill (WS) characteristic.

special_rules.name: Saga of the Wolfkin
special_rules.text: A model with this Saga may join Beast type units even if it is not the Beast type.
